name: Kyouki no Shiosai ~JK Ishukan Horror Dokuhaku ADV~
original_name: 狂気の潮騒～J*異種姦ホラー独白ADV～
source:
The Female Flesh Can Only Be Devoured, Nothing More

I understood that i was drawn to this, and dragged into sea by it.

I cannot comperhend what this monstrous thing thought, or why it chose me

It would be meaningless to describe in human emotions, but perhaps it took a liking to me, and at the same time didn't, and want tot toy with me.

While chattering my teeth, i begged the gods for help.

However, at the bottom of this deep, dark sea, there was only this wicked thing
